extracted.name: Chicken & Biscuits Bake🍗
extracted.description: Need an easy quick weekend night meal? Check out this great recipe if you are trying to figure out what to do with leftovers chicken or simply just need to throw something together for the family. 🔴
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream or half and half
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375*. In a large skillet add butter and onions. Sauté onions until translucent in appearance.
Add flour into skillet and whisk together. Flour should absorb the butter. Slowly whisk in vegetable stock until well combined. Stirring constantly let thicken for about two minutes.
Whisk in half and half and add seasonings. Add in chicken and frozen vegetables. Let simmer, stirring occasionally for five minutes.
Transfer into a baking dish. Top with biscuits dough. Bake in oven for 20 minutes (or until biscuits have turned golden brown.) Cover with tinfoil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes. Serve alongside your favorite side dish or by itself!
